correctness.rationale: From the exact Cornfeld–Sela Meijer-G twist function, use its unlogged endpoint-uniform repeated-pole expansion t_beta(X)=cos(pi beta)+(2 beta/pi)sin(pi beta) XL²+O(XL) for beta in [0,1/2], L=log(1/X). The fixed-beta logarithmic coefficient is singular at beta=1/2 and cannot be integrated directly. With delta=1/2-beta and epsilon=XL², t≈pi delta+epsilon/pi; integrate log(t/cos(pi beta)) over inner delta≤epsilon, overlap epsilon≪delta≪1 and outer region to obtain epsilon/pi² log(1/epsilon)+O(epsilon), equal to X/pi² L²[L-2log L]+O(XL²). Bounded independent high-precision Meijer-G evaluations at two X values and beta up to .499 matched the unlogged expansion within a bounded XL remainder; these samples do not establish its uniformity. The analytic expansion and its uniform remainder are critical imported exact-function asymptotics and remain an explicitly identified replay obligation.
